source.definition: pinned STS2 0.107.1 decompile: Core/Models/AbstractModel.cs declarations, Core/Hooks/Hook.cs dispatchers, Core/Models/** vanilla overrides
source.note: Generated projection of a maintainer-only decompile; never hand-edit it. The decompile's DLL provenance sidecar was not retained, so recheck any fact against the pinned assembly or installed game before promoting it into authoring instruction.

listener_sets.note: Reachability is decided by which listener set the dispatching iterator walks. The run-scope set carries no Powers, Orbs, or Monsters, so a run-only hook overridden on a Power compiles and never fires.

declaration_shapes.note: A collection-edit hook mutates a host-owned list and its bool reports only that it was touched. It cannot be declared as a replacement value, so it needs an add/remove declaration with a composition rule.
